rationale: The selected Diotec 2N2222A data sheet maps E=1, B=2, C=3. Existing PCB nets were B,C,E respectively, so Q1 pins were inconsistent with that manufacturer mapping.
reroutes: IR_BASE moved from Q1 pad 1 to pad 2
IR_LED_K moved from Q1 pad 2 to pad 3 using a bottom-layer escape/via
GND moved from Q1 pad 3 to pad 1
